items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: A fella by the name of Anor, a little short Creole fella, he used to have a show back there.

ctx.x: Where was that show you played where you used the horse's grill?

Well that's used to call it Miro Show. A fella by the name of Anor, a little short Creole fella, he used to have a show back there. He used to run the picture then after the dance. That's an old show back on Miro with the Anzaga and Dabba Dee, something like that. The whole time. The moving pictures then? Yeah, he used to have moving pictures and after you run the picture then after the dance. We played at two o'clock. Running pictures about an hour. See I used to imitate. They didn't have no talking pictures…
Did you ever use the hi-hat or sock cymbal? The one with your left? Yeah, yeah I used the sock cymbal, yeah.
